name: 纠错工程（Correct）
description_zh: 找出仓库里智能体反复犯的同类错误，并让下一个智能体犯不了：优先架构，其次类型，再是可命名修复的 lint，然后是测试，文档最后。每次被纠正就迭代一次。
description_en: Find the mistakes agents keep repeating in this repo and make each one impossible. Try architecture first, then types, then a lint whose error names the fix, then a test, and write docs last. Prove each check fails on a real past mistake. Repeat this each time the operator corrects you. Use for /correct.
